description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewService class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling performance review-related business logic such as activation, updating reviews, managing reviewer ratings, and interacting with the PerformanceReviewDao data access object.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewService
classes.description: A service class providing business logic for handling performance reviews, including activation, updates, and rating management within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the PerformanceReviewDao data access object.

methods.name: activateReview
methods.description: Activates a performance review for an employee given a PerformanceReview object and reviewer employee number.

methods.name: updateActivateReview
methods.description: Updates and activates a performance review, including validation of supervisor and employee status.

methods.name: activateReviewCommonExceptions
methods.description: Checks for requisite conditions like presence of job title and KPI before activating a review.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewRatings
methods.description: Creates reviewer ratings from input data and saves or updates them via DAO.

methods.name: createRatingsFromRows
methods.description: Generates an array of ReviewerRating objects from input row data for a specific review and reviewer group.

methods.name: generateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key string for reviewer rating entries based on reviewer ID, review ID, and KPI ID.
